bank:
I moved our stores out before the garrison could seize them. Food, tools, coins—none of it means much if it is lost on the road.
Your bank is shared with the one waiting on the mainland. Deposit something from your bag, then withdraw it. Worn equipment stays separate.
Keeper Sera waits at the shrine south of the square. Ask her why even a desperate resistance takes time to honour the fallen.
combat:
I swore to protect the people, not the crown. When the soldiers forgot the difference, I left—and brought everyone I could with me. Courage matters. Preparation keeps you alive.
Equip the bronze dagger you made, then inspect your combat stats. After that I will give you a wooden sword and shield. Practise on the dummy before entering the rat pen.
Keep food ready. Defeat a rat and collect its bones and coins. Return to me after collecting its drops for a shortbow, arrows and a ranged lesson across the fence. When you are finished with that lesson, find Forester Ash at the timber yard northwest of the square. Learn to gather logs before you meet Fisher Nell. A fighter needs to know how to make camp as well as how to fight.
cooking:
Rowan says you are our chance to end this. To me, you look like someone who needs a meal. Freedom fighters still get hungry, and no one wins a battle on an empty stomach.
Take this flour and water. Select the flour, then tap the water to make dough. Select the dough and tap the range to bake bread. Keep the food for when you are hurt.
Visit Banker Ada at Firstlight Bank north of the square afterward. She will show you how to store your supplies for the road ahead.
fishing:
We have hidden families along these shores. I can catch supper, hide our tracks, and have the children asleep before a patrol passes. You will need more than a sharp blade in the kingdoms.
Catch shrimp at the marked fishing spot. Hold a log and choose Light fire beside me. Then select your raw shrimp and tap that fire to cook it. There is a tree beside me if you need another log.
Once you have cooked a catch, visit Bram in the kitchen east of the square. He kept our fighters fed through the siege.
guide:
Welcome to the land of Veldren. My name is Rowan. I summoned you from another world. A blight is spreading across Veldren’s three kingdoms, and everyone born under our skies is bound by its curse. You alone came from beyond its reach. You may be the only one who can stop him.
This is Firstlight Isle, a refuge between worlds. I cannot send you into ours unprepared. I gathered these freedom fighters to teach you how to survive there. Each of them has kept our people alive in a different way.
First, open your bag. This is where things go when you pick them up. When every lesson is done, return to me. I will open your one-way crossing to Briarhaven.
magic:
Calling someone across worlds takes more than magic. It takes trust that the person who answers will choose to help. Rowan made that choice. Now yours begins.
Take this staff and these relics. Equip the staff with the Magic icon, then cast at my practice dummy. Wind strike uses an air relic and a mind relic. Your Magic skill grows with practice.
When you have made your first cast, visit Smith Orin at the forge northeast of the square. He will teach you to make a weapon with your own hands.
mining:
We lost the royal forges when the garrisons turned. Every weapon we carry now is made or repaired by our own hands. I will teach you to do the same.
Elowen has shown you what magic can do. Now mine a copper ore and a tin ore in this yard. Select either ore and use it on the furnace, then choose the bronze bar recipe. Select the bar, use it on the anvil, and choose Dagger.
Captain Vale is at the training yard south of the village. Take your dagger to her. She will make sure you know which end to hold.
woods:
I used to supply timber to the king’s garrisons. Now my wood shelters the people they drove from their homes. A fighter who cannot make a camp does not last long.
Tap the marked tree to cut a log. Your axe is on your tool belt. Then find Fisher Nell at Stillwater, west of the square. She will teach you to feed yourself when supplies run out.
worship:
We fight so the living can have a future. We remember the dead so we do not forget why. Our bonds with the spirits began long before the blight.
Bury bones from your bag to train Worship. Then speak to me to choose your first elemental companion. A spirit is a companion, not a possession.
You have learned from each of us now. Return to Rowan in the square when you are ready. He will open the crossing to Briarhaven on the mainland.
